description: No test covers _tool_use_ids' provider_content branch (tool_use blocks with empty tool_calls), which criterion 2 names.
_RaisingReadStore fails from the third get_conversation read, coupling the test to the vendored agent's read count.
Baseline state is three loose locals (baseline_user, baseline_messages, queued_id) with the same two-part check repeated at lines 595, 600 and 611.

_trim_unanswered_tool_use's except ConversationOwnerMismatchError arm logs ERROR with only the conversation id, not the store class criterion 5 requires when truncate_messages raises; the scan-failure arm (299-305) also omits it. Checklist VC-21 confirms.

The test module docstring says a stopped query_database call never leaves an unanswered tool_use, but the trim's failure arms leave it in place and the file's parametrized test asserts so. Checklist VC-15 confirms.
The parametrized trim failure-path test has no case for the owner-mismatch or scan-failure arms.
The 'removed nothing' ERROR message says the next call 'may be rejected' while its siblings say 'will be rejected'; the outcome is the same.
